behavior.arguments: rsi = base pointer; pointer = mem64[rsi+0xf38], then value = f64[pointer]; no other argument register is read
behavior.branch_order: no branches inside the window; one comisd followed by one setae, then ret
behavior.exception_scope: COMISD signals invalid operation for quiet or signaling NaN. MXCSR and exception handlers are not recovered; Python edge helpers model normal completion only.
behavior.low_byte_rule: On normal completion, AL = 1 iff value >= 1.0, else 0. Masked-invalid NaN comparison yields 0; unmasked invalid operation need not reach SETAE/RET. RAX bits 8..63 retain the loaded pointer.
behavior.output_shape: On normal completion, RAX = (loaded_pointer & ~0xff) | gate_bit; source-level return contract unknown
behavior.unsigned_note: COMISD/SETAE uses floating-point comparison flags, not unsigned integer comparison; NaN gives 0 only when invalid operation is masked and comparison completes normally

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
